notes: Single canonical test vector published in RFC 9106 §5.3. `password`, `salt`, `secret`, and `ad` are all hex-encoded raw bytes (not UTF-8 strings). `tag` is the expected 32-byte Argon2id output for the listed parameters. The runtime test in `argon2.test.ts` calls `deriveMasterPasswordKey` with `rawHexPassword: true` and asserts byte-for-byte equality with `tag` — locks the OpenPGP.js argon2id WASM (pinned at 1.0.1) to RFC 9106 conformance for this single input set.
